decision.observation: At 1:00 pm the farmer is still just left of the signpost, which blocks him on the right. The dirt road runs east-west directly below him, and the north path rises at about x 0.65-0.75.
decision.hypothesis: Moving down and right will put him on the road below the signpost and clear it to the east. From there he can head up the north path.
decision.memory: The signpost blocks eastward movement on the grass strip. Go around it by using the road below.
